objective: Pick up blue block using cameras, C12 distance, RPLIDAR table-height map, and movement memory.
distance_interpretation: approx_tip_clearance_mm = c12_distance_mm - 123 when target is aligned in the C12 beam path

resources_verified.mim_box_cameras: ok but too distant/overexposed for pickup proof in this run
resources_verified.pc_camera: present but not useful for arm view in this run

what_worked: hand camera clearly located blue block
table-height RPLIDAR can detect block-scale clusters
movement memory returned to known block approach region
bounded grip/lift attempts were captured with evidence
what_failed: high lift at elbow 72 lost the block from the claws
full-close grip engaged mostly one side of the blue block while the opposite claw closed over the paper marker/table area
hook attempt at base 95 did not retain the block after movement
external camera proof was not strong enough for success confirmation

too high/aggressive; block was lost from claw view

next_attempt_recommendation: Use C12 offset: seek raw distance near 123mm plus desired clearance before final close when beam is aligned with object.
Before closing, require both claw tips to bracket blue pixels, not just one claw contacting the block.
Use smaller base increments around 95-100 and wrist/hand alignment to move the right claw onto the blue block before closing.
Use RPLIDAR table-height diff to verify whether the block leaves the table plane after lift.
Do not mark success unless hand camera plus lidar-plane disappearance or external view confirms pickup.
